source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 12 (PDF 261-279), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
12.1 Structure and properties of the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
1 What are nucleons and nuclides?
(Nucleons aur nuclides kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleons: nucleus ke do qisam ke particles, protons aur neutrons. Nuclides: anaasir ke mukhtalif nuclei (maslan ¹²₆C aur ¹⁴₆C ke nuclei do nuclides hain).

book_ref.quote: Now we can say that the nucleus has two types of particles (neutrons and protons) called nucleons.

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between atomic number and mass number.
(Atomic number aur mass number mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Z protons ginta hai; A tamam nucleons.

book_ref.quote: The number of protons in a nucleus is called the atomic number represented by the symbol Z.

rows: Nucleus mein protons ki tadaad.
Nucleons (protons + neutrons) ki kul tadaad.
Aik element ke tamam isotopes ka aik jaisa.
Mukhtalif isotopes ka mukhtalif.
Misaal: carbon, Z = 6.
Misaal: carbon-14, A = 14.

blocks.prompt:
3 An aluminium nucleus is written ²⁷₁₃Al. Find its number of protons, nucleons and neutrons.
(Aluminium nucleus ²⁷₁₃Al likha jata hai. Is ke protons, nucleons aur neutrons nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Protons Z = 13; nucleons A = 27; neutrons N = A − Z = 27 − 13 = 14.

book_ref.quote: where N represents the neutron number.

blocks.prompt:
4 Define the unified mass unit. Give its value in kg and in MeV.
(Unified mass unit ki definition likhein. Is ki qeemat kg aur MeV mein dein.)
blocks.explanation: 1 u carbon-12 atom ke mass ka theek 1/12 hissa hai. Atomi particles ke mass ke liye kilogram ki jagah istemal hota hai: 1 u = 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 931 MeV.

book_ref.quote: By definition 1u is exactly one twelveth the mass of carbon¹² atom

blocks.prompt:
5 Using 1 u = 931 MeV, find the rest-mass energy of a proton (mass 1.007276 u).
(1 u = 931 MeV le kar proton (mass 1.007276 u) ki rest-mass energy nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: In this unit the mass of a proton is 1.007276 u and that of a neutron is 1.008665 u

blocks.prompt:
6 Define isotopes. Name the stable and the unstable isotopes of carbon.
(Isotopes ki definition likhein. Carbon ke stable aur unstable isotopes ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Isotopes woh nuclei hain jin mein protons barabar magar neutrons mukhtalif hon. Carbon: ¹²₆C aur ¹³₆C stable; ¹⁴₆C unstable hai aur β aur neutrino khaarij kar ke nitrogen ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Nuclei that contain the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons are called isotopes.

blocks.prompt:
7 Name the four fundamental forces of nature in order of increasing relative strength.
(Qudrat ki chaar bunyadi forces ko nisbati taaqat ke barhte hue tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.1 se: gravity (10⁻³⁸) < weak nuclear force (10⁻¹³) < electromagnetic force (10⁻²) < strong nuclear force (1).

book_ref.quote: The four fundamental forces are gravity, electromagnetism, weak nuclear force, and strong nuclear force.

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is the gravitational force significant for the sun and planets but neglected at the atomic level?
(Gravitational force sooraj aur sayyaron ke liye ahem kyun hai magar atomi satah par nazar-andaz kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity masses ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib hai. Sooraj aur sayyaron ke mass bohat bade hain, is liye yeh ahem hai; atomi particles ke mass bohat chhote hain, is liye yeh na-qabil-e-zikr kamzor hai.

book_ref.quote: However, on an atomic level, this force is considered to be negligibly weak.

blocks.prompt:
9 Differentiate between the gravitational force and the electromagnetic force.
(Gravitational force aur electromagnetic force mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono inverse square law maanti hain aur range la-mehdood hai, magar farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Like the gravitational force, the electromagnetic force follows an inverse square law

rows: Chaaron mein sab se kamzor (nisbati taaqat 10⁻³⁸).
Kahin zyada taaqatwar (nisbati taaqat 10⁻²).
Hamesha kashish wali; masses ke darmiyan.
Electric charges aur magnetic fields ke darmiyan.
Sooraj aur sayyaron jaise bhaari ajsaam ke liye ahem.
Atom ki saakht, chemical bonding, bijli, magnetism aur roshni ko control karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
10 Why must a force other than gravity and electromagnetism exist inside the nucleus?
(Nucleus ke andar gravity aur electromagnetism ke ilawa koi aur force kyun honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus ke protons aik doosre ko electric force se dhakelte hain aur gravity bohat kamzor hai. Sirf in do forces se nucleus bikhar jata. Is ka qaaim rehna aik zyada taaqatwar force, strong nuclear force, ki daleel hai.

book_ref.quote: The stability of the nucleus implies that another force should exist within the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between the strong nuclear force and the weak nuclear force.
(Strong nuclear force aur weak nuclear force mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono bohat kam faasle par amal karti hain, magar farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Strong nuclear forces are responsible for holding the nuclei of atoms together.

rows: Atoms ke nuclei ko jode rakhti hai.
Radioactive decay, khaas kar beta decay, ki zimmedar.
Sab se taaqatwar (nisbati taaqat 1).
Nisbati taaqat 10⁻¹³.
Range 10⁻¹⁵ m se kam.
Range 10⁻¹⁸ m se kam.
Tamam nucleons ko yaksaan kheenchti hai.
Particles ki pehchaan badal sakti hai.

blocks.prompt:
12 What special property of the weak nuclear force makes it essential in stars?
(Weak nuclear force ki kaun si khaas khoobi sitaron mein isay zaroori banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Doosri forces ke baraks weak force particles ki pehchaan badal sakti hai (maslan neutron ko proton mein). Is liye yeh sitaron mein nuclear fusion aur unstable nuclei ke decay ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Unlike the other fundamental forces, the weak force can change the identity of particles

blocks.prompt:
13 Using Table 12.1, how many times stronger is the strong force than the electromagnetic force, and than gravity?
(Table 12.1 se strong force electromagnetic force se aur gravity se kitne guna taaqatwar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Strong/electromagnetic = 1/10⁻² = 100 guna. Strong/gravity = 1/10⁻³⁸ = 10³⁸ guna.

book_ref.quote: Table 12.1 Relative strength and range of four fundamental forces

blocks.prompt:
14 What is an anti-particle? Give two examples with their symbols.
(Anti-particle kya hai? Do misalein un ki alamaat ke saath dein.)
blocks.explanation: Anti-particle ka rest mass apne particle ke barabar magar charge ulta hota hai (Dirac ki 1928 ki peshgoi). Misalein: positron e⁺ (electron ka anti-particle), anti-proton p̄; antineutrino ν̄.

book_ref.quote: The rest masses of the anti-particles are the same as that of their corresponding particles but with opposite charges.

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare the electron and the positron.
(Electron aur positron ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh particle aur anti-particle hain.

book_ref.quote: It is represented by e⁺. The rest mass of the positron is the same as that of an electron

rows: Charge −1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
Charge +1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C (wahi magnitude).
Aam maadde ka particle.
Us ka anti-particle; pehla daryaft hone wala (Anderson, 1932).
Rest mass 0.00055 u.
Wahi rest mass, 0.00055 u.

blocks.prompt:
16 What is a particle accelerator? Name three of them.
(Particle accelerator kya hai? Teen ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik bohat badi machine jo electrons, protons ya ions jaise charged particles ko bohat zyada energy aur roshni ke qareeb raftaar tak tez karti hai. Misalein: linear accelerator, cyclotron, betatron.

book_ref.quote: A particle accelerator is a huge machine that accelerates charged particles

blocks.prompt:
17 What are cosmic rays? What happens when they enter the Earth's atmosphere?
(Cosmic rays kya hain? Zameen ki fiza mein daakhil ho kar kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cosmic rays khala se aane wale high-energy particles hain (zyada tar protons, neutrons aur bhaari nuclei), shayad sooraj ya doosre sitaron se. Yeh fiza ki gason ke atoms se takra kar secondary particles ki baarish banati hain.

book_ref.quote: The cosmic rays are high-energy particles coming from the outer-space with unknown sources.

blocks.prompt:
18 Name three sources from which new particles are obtained.
(Teen zaraaye batayein jin se naye particles milte hain.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Cosmic rays ka fiza ke atoms se takraana. (ii) Nuclear reactors mein ²³⁵U jaise nuclei ka fission (neutrons, neutrinos, α, photons, electrons, positrons). (iii) Particle accelerators, jin ki takkar se pions, kaons, muons aur antiprotons bante hain.

book_ref.quote: they emit a variety of particles, such as; neutrons, neutrinos, α-particles, photons, electrons and positrons

blocks.prompt:
19 Define pair production and write the minimum photon energy needed for it.
(Pair production ki definition likhein aur is ke liye photon ki kam se kam energy likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab high-energy gamma photon atomi nucleus ke qareeb se guzarta hai to ghaib ho kar electron-positron jora bana deta hai. Kam se kam energy jore ki rest mass energy 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV hai.

book_ref.quote: Pair production occurs when a gamma ray photon (high energy photon) passes nearby an atomic nucleus.

blocks.prompt:
20 Why is a nucleus needed for pair production?
(Pair production ke liye nucleus kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Energy aur momentum dono aik saath conserve hone chahiye. Qareebi nucleus takkar mein recoil kar ke momentum le leta hai; is liye pair production khala (vacuum) mein nahi ho sakti.

book_ref.quote: The pair production can happen only in the presence of an external object like an atomic nucleus

blocks.prompt:
21 A photon of energy 2.20 MeV produces an electron-positron pair. Find the total kinetic energy of the pair.
(2.20 MeV ka photon electron-positron jora banata hai. Jore ki kul kinetic energy nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Jore ki rest mass energy = 1.02 MeV. Kul KE = 2.20 − 1.02 = 1.18 MeV (electron aur positron mein bat'ti hai).

book_ref.quote: the excess energy goes into the kinetic energies of the particles

blocks.prompt:
22 Show that charge is conserved in pair production.
(Sabit karein ke pair production mein charge conserve rehta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle: photon, charge 0. Baad mein: electron (−e) + positron (+e), kul charge −e + e = 0. Pehle ka charge = baad ka charge.

book_ref.quote: The process of pair production satisfies the laws of conservation of charge, momentum and energy.

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between pair production and annihilation of matter.
(Pair production aur annihilation of matter mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Annihilation pair production ka ulat amal hai.

book_ref.quote: It is the opposite process of pair production.

rows: Gamma photon electron-positron jore mein badalta hai.
Electron aur positron do gamma photons mein badalte hain.
Energy mass mein badalti hai.
Mass energy mein badalta hai.
Nucleus ke qareeb kam az kam 1.02 MeV ka photon chahiye.
Har photon 0.51 MeV le jata hai (saakin electron aur positron).

blocks.prompt:
24 Why does each gamma photon produced in electron-positron annihilation (at rest) have 0.51 MeV?
(Electron-positron annihilation (saakin) mein har gamma photon ki energy 0.51 MeV kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul rest mass energy 2m₀c² = 1.02 MeV do photons mein badalti hai; energy aur momentum conservation se dono barabar baant'te hain, har aik ko m₀c² = 0.51 MeV, yani aik electron ki rest mass energy.

book_ref.quote: The energy of each gamma ray photon is 0.51 MeV

blocks.prompt:
25 A proton (rest-mass energy 938 MeV) and an antiproton annihilate at rest. Find the total energy released.
(Aik proton (rest-mass energy 938 MeV) aur antiproton saakin haalat mein annihilate hote hain. Kul kitni energy niklti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antiproton ka rest mass proton ke barabar hai. E = 2 × 938 = 1876 MeV ≈ 1.88 GeV.

book_ref.quote: the annihilation reactions of other particles and their anti-particles can also be carried out

blocks.prompt:
26 Differentiate between natural and artificial radioactivity.
(Natural aur artificial radioactivity mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein radiation aik jaisi hai; farq unstable nucleus banne ke tareeqe mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Such nuclei are called radioactive and the emission of radiation is known as natural radioactivity.

rows: Qudrati unstable nuclei khud ba khud radiation dete hain.
Lab mein unstable banaye gaye nuclei radiation dete hain.
Atomic number 82 se zyada wale nuclei.
Stable elements par neutrons, protons, α ya γ barsaye jate hain.
Bahar ki kisi wajah ki zaroorat nahi.
Nuclear reactions se bante hain; inhein radioisotopes kehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
27 How does an electric field show the nature of charge on α, β and γ radiations?
(Electric field α, β aur γ radiations ke charge ki nauiyat kaise zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: α-particles negative terminal ki taraf mudte hain, is liye positive hain. β-particles positive terminal ki taraf mudte hain, is liye negative hain. γ seedhi guzar jati hain, is liye charge nahi (Fig. 12.4).

book_ref.quote: α-particles deflect towards the negative terminal of the electric field

blocks.prompt:
28 Why are β-particles deflected more than α-particles in an electric field?
(Electric field mein β-particles α-particles se zyada kyun mudte hain?)
blocks.explanation: β-particles tez electrons hain jo α-particles (helium nuclei) se bohat halke hain. Halka charged particle field se zyada aasani se mudta hai, is liye zyada deflection hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The deflection of β-particles is more than the α-particles

blocks.prompt:
29 Why do α-particles travel only several centimetres in air though they are emitted at high speed?
(α-particles tez raftaar se nikalne ke bawajood hawa mein sirf chand centimetre kyun chalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Un ka mass bara aur charge 2e hai, is liye woh hawa ko bohat ionize karte hain (fi mm taqreeban 10⁴ ion pairs) aur jaldi energy kho dete hain; kaghaz ki sheet unhein rok leti hai.

book_ref.quote: α-particles can travel only several centimetres in the air due to their large mass

blocks.prompt:
30 Why do γ-rays have the highest penetrating power?
(γ-rays ki penetrating power (ghusne ki salahiyat) sab se zyada kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: γ-rays be-charge photons hain jo roshni ki raftaar se chalti hain. Un ki ionization sab se kam hai (fi mm taqreeban 1 ion pair), is liye energy aahista khoti hain aur unhein rokne ke liye 1-10 cm lead chahiye.

book_ref.quote: They move with the speed of light with the highest penetrating power but the lowest ionization power.

blocks.prompt:
31 Write the general equation of α-decay and explain the changes in Z and A.
(α-decay ki aam equation likhein aur Z aur A ki tabdeeli bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ⁻⁴_(Z−2) Y + ⁴₂He. Nucleus do protons aur do neutrons (helium nucleus) kho deta hai, is liye Z 2 aur A 4 kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Here ᴬ_Z X is is the parent nucleus which decays into the daughter nucleus

blocks.prompt:
32 What is transmutation of elements? Give an example.
(Transmutation of elements kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nuclear decay se aik element ka doosre mein badalna. Misaal: radium-226 α-particle de kar radon-222 ban jata hai: ²²⁶₈₈Ra → ²²²₈₆Rn + ⁴₂He.

book_ref.quote: This transition of one element into another is called the transmutation of the elements.

blocks.prompt:
33 What is the disintegration energy (Q-value) of a decay?
(Kisi decay ki disintegration energy (Q-value) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Parent nucleus ka mass products ke kul mass se zyada hota hai, is liye products ki mass-energy (E = mc²) kam hoti hai. Mass-energy ka yeh farq disintegration energy Q hai.

book_ref.quote: This difference in mass-energy is called the disintegration energy Q

blocks.prompt:
34 In an α-decay the mass of the parent exceeds the total mass of the daughter and the α-particle by 0.0080 u. Find Q using 1 u = 931 MeV.
(Aik α-decay mein parent ka mass daughter aur α-particle ke kul mass se 0.0080 u zyada hai. 1 u = 931 MeV le kar Q nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: It is experimentally found that the mass of the parent nucleus is greater than the total mass

blocks.prompt:
35 Where do β⁻-particles come from when the nucleus has no electrons?
(Jab nucleus mein electrons nahi hote to β⁻-particles kahan se aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh khaarij hone ke lamhe nucleus ke andar bante hain: aik neutron proton, electron aur antineutrino mein badalta hai (n → p + e⁻ + ν̄). Charge conserve rakhne ke liye electron nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The β-particles are not the orbital electrons but they are created within the nucleus at the moment of emission.

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between β⁻-decay and β⁺-decay.
(β⁻-decay aur β⁺-decay mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mein A wahi rehta hai; Z aik badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: In this process, a proton in the nucleus decays into a neutron and a positron, plus a neutrino.

rows: Jab N/P bohat zyada ho.
Jab N/P bohat kam ho.
Neutron badalta hai: n → p + e⁻ + ν̄.
Proton neutron, positron aur neutrino mein badalta hai.
Electron aur antineutrino nikalte hain.
Positron aur neutrino nikalte hain.
Z aik barhta hai: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z+1) Y + e⁻ + ν̄.
Z aik ghatta hai: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z−1) Y + e⁺ + ν.

blocks.prompt:
37 A nucleus ¹³⁷₅₅Cs emits a β⁻-particle. Find A and Z of the daughter nucleus.
(Nucleus ¹³⁷₅₅Cs aik β⁻-particle khaarij karta hai. Daughter nucleus ka A aur Z nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: β⁻-decay mein A wahi rehta hai aur Z aik barhta hai: A = 137, Z = 55 + 1 = 56.

book_ref.quote: the parent element of atomic number Z is transmuted to another element of atomic number (Z+1)

blocks.prompt:
38 Why are neutrinos very difficult to detect?
(Neutrinos ko detect karna bohat mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutrinos aur antineutrinos ka charge sifr aur mass bohat kam hai, is liye maadde se guzarte hue mushkil se ta'amul karte hain. Pauli ne 1930 mein khayal diya; yeh 1953 mein high-power nuclear reactor mein detect hua.

book_ref.quote: Both the neutrino and the anti-neutrino have zero charge and very small mass

blocks.prompt:
39 What does the graph of the number of α-particles against kinetic energy (Fig. 12.5) show?
(α-particles ki tadaad aur kinetic energy ka graph (Fig. 12.5) kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Graph mein waazeh spikes hain: kisi khaas radionuclide ka har α-particle aik hi mukarrar kinetic energy rakhta hai. Yani α-particles ki energies discrete hain.

book_ref.quote: every emitted α-particle has the same sharply defined kinetic energy

blocks.prompt:
40 In a β⁻-decay 2.30 MeV is released. If the antineutrino takes 1.45 MeV, what is the electron's energy? What is the most the electron can have?
(Aik β⁻-decay mein 2.30 MeV niklti hai. Agar antineutrino 1.45 MeV le to electron ki energy kitni hai? Electron zyada se zyada kitni le sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Majmua wahi rehta hai: electron ki energy = 2.30 − 1.45 = 0.85 MeV. Zyada se zyada 2.30 MeV, jab antineutrino ko taqreeban kuch na mile.

book_ref.quote: The sum of electron (or positron) energy and the anti-neutrino's (or neutrino's) energy

blocks.prompt:
41 Write the equation for γ-emission. Why do A and Z not change?
(γ-emission ki equation likhein. A aur Z kyun nahi badalte?)
blocks.explanation: ᴬ_Z X* → ᴬ_Z X + γ. Excited nucleus X* photon de kar ground state mein aata hai. Photon ka na charge hai na nucleon, is liye A aur Z wahi rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: represents an excited nucleus while

blocks.prompt:
42 Compare α-particles and γ-rays in nature, ionization and absorption (Table 12.2).
(Table 12.2 se α-particles aur γ-rays ka nauiyat, ionization aur jazb hone mein muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Table 12.2 se:

book_ref.quote: Table 12.2: The summary of nature of alpha, beta and gamma radiations

rows: Helium nuclei, charge 2e.
Excited nuclei se electromagnetic waves, charge nahi.
Hawa mein fi mm taqreeban 10⁴ ion pairs.
Hawa mein fi mm taqreeban 1 ion pair.
Kaghaz ki sheet se ruk jate hain.
1-10 cm lead se rukti hain.
Raftaar ~10⁷ m s⁻¹.
Raftaar ~3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
43 What is meant by a fundamental particle? Which particles are presently considered fundamental?
(Fundamental particle se kya muraad hai? Is waqt kaun se particles fundamental maane jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fundamental particle ki koi androoni saakht nahi hoti, yani woh na-qabil-e-taqseem hai. Is waqt quarks (jin se protons, neutrons aur mesons bane hain) aur leptons (electrons, positrons, neutrinos) maadde ke bunyadi ajza hain.

book_ref.quote: By the term fundamental particle, we mean a particle that has no internal structure

blocks.prompt:
44 What are strange particles? Give the reaction in which they are produced.
(Strange particles kya hain? Woh reaction likhein jis mein yeh bante hain.)
blocks.explanation: High-energy takkaron mein bane woh particles jo theoretical scheme mein fit nahi hue, strange particles kehlaye. Yeh hamesha joron mein bante hain, maslan π⁻ + p → k⁰ + Λ⁰.

book_ref.quote: Many of these were accounted well with the scheme of theoretical physicist while the rest were named

blocks.prompt:
45 State Pauli's exclusion principle as given in the chapter. Which particles obey it?
(Chapter ke mutabiq Pauli's exclusion principle bayan karein. Kaun se particles ise maante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik qisam ka sirf aik particle kisi aik quantum state mein reh sakta hai. Aadhe spin wale particles (electrons, protons, neutrons) ise maante hain jo fermions kehlate hain.

book_ref.quote: Half spin particles obey the Pauli's exclusion principle

blocks.prompt:
46 Classify the electron, the photon and the pion as fermion or boson, giving their spins.
(Electron, photon aur pion ko un ke spin ke saath fermion ya boson mein taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electron: spin 1/2, fermion. Photon: spin 1, boson. Pion: spin 0, boson (sifr ya poore spin wale bosons hain).

book_ref.quote: the spin of photon is 1 and of pions is taken as zero

blocks.prompt:
47 How does β-decay show that protons and neutrons are not fundamental particles?
(β-decay kaise zahir karta hai ke protons aur neutrons fundamental particles nahi?)
blocks.explanation: β⁻-decay mein neutron proton ban jata hai aur β⁺-decay mein proton neutron. Jo particle doosre mein badal sake us ki androoni saakht honi chahiye, is liye protons aur neutrons fundamental nahi.

book_ref.quote: Both of the β-decay (beta-minus and beta-plus) processes provide evidence

blocks.prompt:
48 What are hadrons? Name their two categories.
(Hadrons kya hain? In ki do qismein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Hadrons murakkab particles hain jo strong force mehsoos karte hain. In ki qismein: (i) mesons, jo bosons hain (maslan pion), (ii) baryons, jo fermions hain (maslan proton, neutron).

book_ref.quote: Those that experience the strong force are known as hadrons

blocks.prompt:
49 Differentiate between baryons and mesons.
(Baryons aur mesons mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hadrons hain, magar farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Baryons are made of an odd number of quarks (usually three quarks)

rows: Taaq tadaad ke quarks, aam taur par teen.
Juft tadaad ke quarks, aam taur par aik quark aur aik antiquark.
Fermions (aadha spin).
Bosons (sifr ya poora spin).
Misalein: proton, neutron, Λ⁰.
Misalein: pion, kaon.

blocks.prompt:
50 Why are leptons considered truly fundamental particles?
(Leptons ko haqeeqi fundamental particles kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi tajurbe ne leptons mein koi androoni saakht zahir nahi ki; inhein mazeed chhote particles mein toda nahi ja sakta. Tamam leptons ka spin ½ hai aur woh fermions hain.

book_ref.quote: No experiments have yet been able to reveal any internal structure for the leptons

blocks.prompt:
51 Name the six leptons as three pairs.
(Chhe leptons ko teen joron ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Electron e⁻ aur electron neutrino νₑ; muon μ⁻ aur muon neutrino ν_μ; tau τ⁻ aur tau neutrino ν_τ. Har aik ka anti-particle bhi hai.

book_ref.quote: The six known leptons are grouped as three pairs of particles as shown in Table 12.3.

blocks.prompt:
52 Using Table 12.3, find how many times heavier the tau is than the electron.
(Table 12.3 se nikalein ke tau electron se kitne guna bhaari hai.)
blocks.explanation: Tau 1777 MeV/c², electron 0.511 MeV/c². Nisbat = 1777/0.511 = 3477 ≈ 3480 guna.

book_ref.quote: Table 12.3: The lepton family

blocks.prompt:
